description: Merge a raw XMP XML patch into a project item's existing XMP metadata without removing unrelated fields. WARNING: Premiere writes XMP into the source media file on disk (the file's metadata block and modification time change; picture and sound are untouched). Requires the filesystem capability.

item_id.description: Node ID or name of the project item

xmp_xml.description: Well-formed XMP XML containing only the fields to add or replace

name: set_xmp_metadata

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Xmp Metadata
